note: v3355: v3325 was titled a store is never written over an unread one and it put that rule in THREE loaders, every one written as except IOError return empty-dict with except Exception return None beneath it, commented malformed/unreadable. In Python 3 IOError IS OSError - measured True - and PermissionError, IsADirectoryError and the EMFILE family are all subclasses, so an EXISTING GOOD store that merely could not be READ took the ABSENT arm. The second arm only ever saw MALFORMED: a JSON error is a ValueError, an unreadable FILE is an OSError. MEASURED on a real file holding watermarks 179, 180 and 230 at mode 000: _marks returned empty and --mark would then write one key over it, destroying all three - the exact wipe the v3325 own docstring says must never happen, surviving inside the fix written to prevent it and separated from it only by an errno the except clause cannot see. The three sites are handoff._marks, control_app._shadow_watch_stored and control_app._rnf_load, and every one of them feeds a caller that writes the whole dict back. ⚠⚠ THE PROSE ABOVE EACH SITE ALREADY DESCRIBED THE DEFECT: the _shadow_watch_stored comment, written in v3325, says in as many words that returning empty for a store it could not read REPLACES that store with just the new keys - and the code directly beneath it did exactly that. A comment stating a rule the adjacent code does not implement is worse than no comment, because it makes the next reader believe the case is handled. THE CLASS WAS SWEPT AND THE UNSCOPED NUMBER IS ON THE RECORD: 127 handlers in tv/ catch IOError or OSError broadly; THREE are this defect, the ones where a falsy value reaches a caller that writes the whole store back, and the rest return None, raise, or say why. The correct idiom was already in the same file three times. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE RATCHET COULD NOT SEE ITS OWN FIX, which is the more useful half: swallow_census ranked on what a handler RETURNS and never on what it CATCHES, so except FileNotFoundError and except OSError returning the same empty dict were one rank - opposite facts, one number - and the three repairs moved the count by ZERO. A ratchet whose number survives the repair of the thing it flagged teaches its reader to re-baseline, which is the one move the census docstring calls the defect. It now asks the exception class too, and narrowly: a bare except gets no pass, except Exception gets no pass, and a tuple carrying one wider name gets no pass. MEASURED, 6 of 76 rank-1 sites catch absence only, so rank1 goes 76 to 70 and the baseline moves DOWN with it in this same commit - test_agent.py leaves rank1 entirely and control_app goes 34 to 31. ⚠ The baseline other counters jump (handlers 2116 to 3210, rank2 819 to 1191, rank3 964 to 1624) because the old file was written long ago and the tree has grown; the ratchet enforces rank1 alone and rank1 is the only number this version reasons about. ⚠⚠ CI HAD BEEN SHOUTING FOR TEN CONSECUTIVE RUNS. Routine M reported 76 against a baseline of 74 on every push from at least v3344 to v3353 and nothing surfaced it, because the pre-push hook derives its gates from CHANGED TEST FILES and never runs the full set - so the only reader was a CI page nobody opened. A red nobody reads is the same as a green, so a console_doctor row now carries the count WITH its baseline, and it went through two of its own defects on the way: a bare io.open in a module that does not import io, and a flat sum over a nested baseline. Both were named by its UNKNOWN arm rather than swallowed, which is the only reason each took one run instead of forever. 478 gates, 11 cases, 5 red-proofs PROVEN. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE CROSS-FAMILY EYE FOUND A REAL RACE IN v3354, FIXED HERE, REPRODUCED BEFORE BELIEVING IT: the corroborator shipped yesterday had each of its two sides call _rows_with_reach() for itself, and the ledger is APPEND-ONLY with second_eye_run --answer-in writing to it - so one row landing between the two calls makes a perfectly healthy store report DISAGREE. Reproduced by handing the sides populations of 1 and 2 rows: left 0, right 1, relation == false, no defect anywhere. The asymmetric case is worse, one side None and the other a number reading as UNKNOWN, which is the agreement-about-nothing that invariant exists to refuse. It now takes ONE snapshot and both sides judge it. Sharing the SUBJECT is not self-corroboration: what must stay independent is the METHOD, the stored dict on one side and git on the other, and two sides judging different rows corroborate nothing at all. The eye third finding, duplicate paths inside one absent list, is NOT fixed and the reason is measured: absent comes from git show --name-only, which never emits a path twice for one commit, and both sides would count a duplicate identically so the comparison still holds. It is a stated limit, not a defect. 12 cases on that law, 5 red-proofs, 10 of 10 PROVEN across both laws this version touches. ⚠⚠⚠⚠ AND THE PUSH GATE REFUSED MY OWN NEW ROW, CORRECTLY, WHICH IS THE LAST CORRECTION HERE: the swallowed reads doctor row parses every python file in the tree to recount the census, and test_control test_the_cheap_subset_is_actually_CHEAP blocked the push at 3,668 ms and 3,272 ms on retry against a 3,000 ms budget. It had PASSED a full 2,238-test test_control run minutes earlier, and measuring it four times on an idle machine says why: 2,436 / 2,436 / 2,455 / 2,433 ms - about 550 ms of headroom, which is luck rather than cheapness. The cheap subset runs on the watchdog ten-minute timer AND at every console boot. So it joins PERIODIC and not SLOW, because SLOW means NEVER RUNS UNATTENDED and a ratchet nobody reads is the precise defect this row exists for - it had been red in CI for ten runs with no surface at all. Precedent tier: engines corroborate at 6,638-13,038 ms and sweep would find at 1,660-16,585 ms. ⚠ My own earlier test_control run reading OK was a SAMPLE at one machine load and I read it as a verdict; the gate is what caught it.
